title: Login/Logout, Public Visibility Fixes, TTS PWA Fix, Admin Controls & Photo Optimization

requirements.summary: Implement one-click Internet Identity login/logout with no intermediate password prompt
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking the login button launches Internet Identity directly without any intermediate password form
Google/passkey option is presented in the Internet Identity popup
After login, the UI shows a visible logout button
Clicking logout clears the session and returns the user to the unauthenticated state
No custom password field is rendered anywhere in the login flow

file_operations.description: Ensure the login button directly invokes the Internet Identity flow without any intermediate prompts or password fields. Verify that the authorization component's usage instructions are followed for immediate II launch. The button must call login() from useInternetIdentity immediately on click when unauthenticated, and call clear() followed by queryClient.clear() when authenticated. Ensure the logout button remains visible at all times when the user is authenticated.

Ensure the LoginButton is rendered in the header and remains visible at all times. Remove any conditional logic that might hide the logout button when authenticated. Verify that no password input or custom authentication UI is rendered anywhere in the layout.

requirements.summary: Fix Vrat Katha public visibility so uploaded kathas are immediately visible to unauthenticated users
acceptanceCriteria: A Vrat Katha uploaded/published by admin appears in the listing for unauthenticated users immediately
The backend getKathas (or equivalent) query returns published kathas for anonymous callers
No login is required to browse or read Vrat Kathas
Admin-only drafts or pending items are still hidden from public

file_operations.description: Ensure the page calls getAllKathayen (which returns all published kathas) without any authentication checks. Remove any conditional rendering that hides kathas from unauthenticated users. Merge backend data with static katha data and display all items publicly. Verify that the useGetAllKathayen query does not require authentication and displays results for anonymous visitors.

Ensure the katha detail page loads and displays content for unauthenticated users. Remove any authentication guards or login prompts that might block public access to the katha text, narration controls, and sharing features. Verify the useGetKatha query works for anonymous callers.

Review the useGetAllKathayen and useGetKatha hooks to ensure they do not add authentication checks or enabled flags that block anonymous calls. The backend methods getAllKathayen and getKatha must be callable without authentication, so ensure the hooks reflect this by not requiring an authenticated actor.

requirements.summary: Fix Community posts public visibility so admin-approved posts are visible to all users including unauthenticated visitors
acceptanceCriteria: Approved community posts are visible on the Community page to logged-out users
Backend getCommunityPosts (or equivalent) returns approved posts for anonymous callers
Pending or rejected posts remain hidden from public
Authenticated users and anonymous users see the same set of approved posts

file_operations.description: Modify the Community page to call getApprovedCommunityPosts (which returns only approved posts) for public display, ensuring this query works for unauthenticated users. Remove any authentication guards that hide the approved posts list from anonymous visitors. Keep the post creation form visible only to authenticated users, but ensure the approved posts feed is always public. Verify that the useGetApprovedCommunityPosts query does not require authentication.

Review and update the useGetApprovedCommunityPosts hook to ensure it does not add authentication checks or enabled flags that block anonymous calls. The backend method getApprovedCommunityPosts must be callable without authentication, so the hook should allow the query to run for unauthenticated users. Ensure the query is enabled as long as the actor is available, regardless of authentication state.

Ensure the CommunityPostCard renders approved posts for all users without any authentication checks. Remove any conditional logic that might hide post content, images, videos, or file attachments from unauthenticated visitors. The like button and author information should be visible to all users.

requirements.summary: Fix Narration (TTS) in PWA/installed app by implementing PWA-compatible TTS strategy
acceptanceCriteria: TTS narration plays correctly when the app is installed and opened as a PWA on Android/iOS
Voices load properly on first use inside the PWA without requiring a page reload
Narration controls (play/pause/stop) are functional in the PWA environment
No silent failure — if TTS is unavailable an appropriate message is shown to the user

file_operations.description: Update the useSpeechNarration hook to support PWA environments. Implement a PWA-compatible TTS strategy that handles the Chrome Android PWA bug where voices are not loaded until an utterance event fires. Add logic to re-initialize the Speech Synthesis API after page visibility changes (using the Page Visibility API). Include a fallback resume mechanism to prevent silent blocking of narration. On mount and after visibility changes, check if voices are loaded; if not, trigger a dummy utterance to force voice loading. Add error handling that shows a user-facing message if TTS is unavailable or fails in the PWA context. Ensure the hook works correctly in KathaDetail, AartiDetail, Bhajans, Mantras, and Chalisa pages when the app is installed as a PWA.

Verify that the narration controls using useSpeechNarration work correctly in the PWA environment. Add a visible error message or toast if TTS fails or is unavailable. Test that play/pause/stop controls function properly after the PWA has been backgrounded and foregrounded.

Verify that the narration controls using useSpeechNarration work correctly in the PWA environment. Add a visible error message or toast if TTS fails or is unavailable. Ensure the aarti text narration is not silently blocked in the installed PWA.

Verify that per-bhajan narration using useSpeechNarration works correctly in the PWA environment. Add error handling to show a message if TTS is unavailable. Ensure that each bhajan's play/pause controls function properly in the installed app.

Verify that per-mantra narration using useSpeechNarration works correctly in the PWA environment. Add error handling to show a message if TTS is unavailable. Ensure that each mantra's play/pause controls function properly in the installed app.

Verify that Chalisa narration using useSpeechNarration works correctly in the PWA environment. Add a visible error message or toast if TTS fails or is unavailable. Ensure the Hanuman Chalisa text narration is not silently blocked in the installed PWA.

requirements.summary: Implement Community Admin Control panel with approval queue for pending community posts
acceptanceCriteria: Admin Panel has a 'Pending Posts' or 'Approval Queue' tab
Each pending post shows its content, author, and timestamp
Admin can click Accept to approve a post (it becomes visible to public)
Admin can click Reject to decline a post (it is not shown publicly)
Admin can click Delete to permanently remove any post
Non-admin users cannot access approval or delete functions
After an action, the queue updates to reflect the new state

file_operations.description: Add a new 'Community Approval Queue' tab to the AdminPanel. This tab must display all pending community posts by calling the useGetPendingCommunityPosts query hook. For each pending post, render a card showing the post content (text, images, videos, file attachments), author Principal, and timestamp. Provide three action buttons: 'Accept' (calls approveCommunityPost mutation), 'Reject' (calls rejectCommunityPost mutation), and 'Delete' (calls deleteCommunityPost mutation). Ensure these actions are only accessible to authenticated admin users (check with useIsCallerAdmin). After any action, invalidate the pending posts query to refresh the queue. Also add a section or tab listing already-approved posts with a 'Delete' button for each, allowing admins to remove approved posts. Ensure all UI updates reflect the new post state immediately.

Add or verify the useGetPendingCommunityPosts query hook that calls getPendingCommunityPosts from the backend. Add or verify mutation hooks for approveCommunityPost, rejectCommunityPost, and deleteCommunityPost, ensuring they invalidate the 'communityPosts' and 'pendingCommunityPosts' query keys on success. Verify that the authorization component's usage instructions are followed, ensuring these hooks are only enabled when the caller is authenticated and has admin permissions.

requirements.summary: Optimize Community Photos loading speed with lazy loading, dimension hints, and blob URL caching
acceptanceCriteria: Community post images use native lazy loading
A skeleton/placeholder is shown while images are loading
Images below the fold do not block initial page render
Blob URLs for backend-stored images are cached and not recreated on every render
Visible improvement in perceived load time for the Community page

file_operations.description: Add native lazy loading to all tags by setting the loading='lazy' attribute. For images that are ExternalBlob instances, cache the result of getDirectURL() using useMemo to avoid recreating blob URLs on every render. Add explicit width and height attributes or CSS dimensions to prevent layout shift while images load. Display a skeleton placeholder (e.g., a gray rectangle with a pulse animation) while the image is loading by using the onLoad event. Apply the same optimizations to video elements if applicable. Verify that the blob-storage component's usage instructions are followed when displaying images. Ensure that images below the fold do not block the initial render of the page.

Ensure the Community page renders CommunityPostCard components in a way that supports lazy loading (e.g., not using display:none that would load all images immediately). Verify that the post list container does not force all images to load at once. If the page uses infinite scroll or pagination, ensure only visible posts are rendered initially. Add a loading skeleton for the entire post list while the approved posts are being fetched.
